subject.title: [Feature] Compaction progress visibility for webchat + watchdog diagnostics API

question: Should OpenClaw add a compaction-specific staged Gateway/WebChat diagnostics contract, and which compaction facts are safe to expose to users or operators?
rationale: The missing behavior is real by source inspection, but the fix adds public event/API or CLI surface, diagnostic retention/redaction policy, and overlaps the already-decided plugin path for Session Memory-style running summaries.

options.title: Narrow core observability contract
options.body: Extend the existing compact operation and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, and failure metadata, while documenting running-summary behavior as a context-engine plugin pattern.

options.title: Docs and existing notices only
options.body: Keep current start/end indicators, notifyUser, compaction-notifier, and diagnostics.stability, then improve docs so users can discover the existing knobs and plugin path.

options.title: Dedicated diagnostics API
options.body: Add a new compaction-specific endpoint or CLI with explicit operator scope, retention limits, and redaction rules for lock/model/session details.

recommendation.title: Narrow core observability contract
recommendation.body: Extend the existing compact operation and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, and failure metadata, while documenting running-summary behavior as a context-engine plugin pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current routing signal is the merged WebChat compaction progress work and current compact operation event path.
